lines: Gibbs has carried 21.7 times per game over his last 3, close to his 22.2 season rate, while his snaps dipped to 70% from 76%.
He has scored 15 touchdowns and averages 28.1 PPR points per game this season, with 109.8 rushing yards per game.
Detroit faces Chicago in Week 12 with an implied team total of 26.5 points, and Dan Campbell said the run game will keep leaning on him.
